item.title: University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
item.description:
Organisation: UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg

Location: Johannesburg, South Africa. Both physical and remote residencies can be applied for, though office, studio, rehearsal and performance space is limited and not guaranteed.

Award: Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.

Duration: 10 months during 2027

Deadline: Closed 31 Aug 2026

UJ Arts & Culture's annual residency gives artists a monthly stipend and an institutional base at the University of Johannesburg for ten months, with the option of a remote rather than physical residency. Disciplines covered are visual and fine arts, music, theatre, performance and dance, design, film and television, and literary arts. A virtual information session with Pieter Jacobs, Head of UJ Arts & Culture, was scheduled for 17 August 2026 to walk applicants through the process. ELIGIBILITY: applicants must hold a relevant post-school qualification, with preference for master's and PhD holders, and must not be affiliated with another tertiary institution in South Africa. Preference has historically gone to artists with African connections. APPLICATION: via the online form linked from the UJ Arts & Culture residency page; contact kmachoga@uj.ac.za or +27 11 559 1476 with questions. DEADLINE: 31 August 2026. No fee.
